content: However long the night may linger, the dawn will surely break.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: Despair is the optical illusion that the present midnight will last forever. But the celestial cycle has never failed: the earth continues to turn, and no shadow has ever possessed the power to halt the rising sun. Hold on through the coldest watch of the night.
practicalInsight: If you are walking through grief or emotional darkness today, do not make permanent decisions. Just endure until dawn.
reflectionPrompt: What season of darkness are you currently navigating, and can you feel the promise of the inevitable sunrise?
